Welcome to the third installment of Navaras by Rishab Rikhiram Sharma: "Chanakya"
Chanakya by Rishab Rikhiram Sharma is an ode to the greatest kingmaker in History: Chanakya (also known as Kautilya) Who was instrumental in helping Chandragupta as his guru to overthrow the powerful Nanda dynasty at Pataliputra. This song is the third installment from the album 'Navaras' by Rishab. Along with larger than life orchestration and sound design this song, targets the emotion of victory of good over evil and freedom.
Song: Chanakya
